introduction.situation: Arts and literature covers works made in many media, from text and stage to sound, image and screen.
introduction.complication: Existing groupings mix media, national traditions and thesaurus facets, so the same aspect of a work appears under many headings.
introduction.question: How is everything in arts and literature divided?
introduction.answer: Arts and literature is divided by the feature of the work that a claim is about, running from the material object outward to judgment: medium and making, form, meaning, context and reception, and value.

governing_thought: Arts and literature is divided by the feature of the work that a claim is about, running from the material object outward to judgment: medium and making, form, meaning, context and reception, and value.

key_line.mece_dimension: the feature of the work that a claim is about
key_line.rank_note: The aspects run from the material object outward to judgment of the work.

points.title: Medium and making
points.statement: Medium and making is the aspect of the work concerned with the material or expressive medium in which it is made and the practice of making it.
points.name: Medium and making is the aspect of the work concerned with the material or expressive medium in which it is made and the practice of making it.

support.rank_note: Sections run from text and stage, to sound, to image and object.

points.statement: Written and performed work is made in text or on the embodied stage, whether creative, professional or live, and includes creative arts not otherwise specified.
points.name: Written and performed work is made in text or on the embodied stage, whether creative, professional or live, and includes creative arts not otherwise specified.

support.rank_note: From writing to live performance to the residual creative category.

points.statement: Creative-oriented writing covers work where the feature in focus is imaginative, digital, or place-based expression in text.
points.name: Creative-oriented writing covers work where the feature in focus is imaginative, digital, or place-based expression in text.

points.statement: Creative and professional writing not elsewhere classified
points.name: Creative and professional writing not elsewhere classified

support.rank_note: Ordered as listed in ANZSRC code sequence.

points.statement: Professional and technical writing covers work where the feature in focus is informing audiences through journalism or specialised documentation.
points.name: Professional and technical writing covers work where the feature in focus is informing audiences through journalism or specialised documentation.

support.rank_note: Ordered as listed in ANZSRC code sequence.

points.statement: Performing arts cover work where the feature in focus is live embodied performance in theatre, dance, and community settings.
points.name: Performing arts cover work where the feature in focus is live embodied performance in theatre, dance, and community settings.

support.rank_note: Ordered as listed in ANZSRC code sequence.

points.statement: Music work has sound as its medium and covers its study, its practice and its instruction.
points.name: Music work has sound as its medium and covers its study, its practice and its instruction.

support.rank_note: From study to practice to general instruction.

points.statement: Music studies cover work where the feature in focus is understanding, teaching, and analysing music as a subject of inquiry.
points.name: Music studies cover work where the feature in focus is understanding, teaching, and analysing music as a subject of inquiry.

support.rank_note: Ordered as listed in ANZSRC code sequence.

points.statement: Music practice covers work where the feature in focus is the making, performing, and recording of music.
points.name: Music practice covers work where the feature in focus is the making, performing, and recording of music.

support.rank_note: Ordered as listed in ANZSRC code sequence.

points.statement: Music work concerns the art of sound, including its instruction and study.
points.name: Music work concerns the art of sound, including its instruction and study.

support.rank_note: Ordered by structure, from music in general to its instruction and study.

points.statement: Visual and screen work is made in images, objects or screens, from hand-made crafts to digital and moving-image production.
points.name: Visual and screen work is made in images, objects or screens, from hand-made crafts to digital and moving-image production.

support.rank_note: From moving image and digital work to broad and hand-made object arts.

points.statement: Moving-image and screen-based work covers film, screen media and visual effects as studied and produced for the screen.
points.name: Moving-image and screen-based work covers film, screen media and visual effects as studied and produced for the screen.

points.statement: Screen and digital media not elsewhere classified
points.name: Screen and digital media not elsewhere classified

support.rank_note: Ordered by structure, from the general screen field to specific screen forms.

points.statement: Interactive and digital-art work is made with computing technology, such as games, animation, electronic art and interactive media.
points.name: Interactive and digital-art work is made with computing technology, such as games, animation, electronic art and interactive media.

support.rank_note: Ordered by structure across the computing-based forms.

points.statement: General visual arts categories are the broad umbrella fields for visual art practice, including residual and performance or lens-based forms.
points.name: General visual arts categories are the broad umbrella fields for visual art practice, including residual and performance or lens-based forms.

support.rank_note: Ordered by structure, from the broad fields to their general subdivisions.

points.statement: Hand-made and traditional object-based art work covers crafts, fine arts, sculpture, drawing and painting made as physical artworks.
points.name: Hand-made and traditional object-based art work covers crafts, fine arts, sculpture, drawing and painting made as physical artworks.

support.rank_note: Ordered by structure across the traditional physical media.

points.statement: Print media, photography, and handicrafts are distinct kinds of visual and material art forms, each defined by the medium or technique used to make the work.
points.name: Print media, photography, and handicrafts are distinct kinds of visual and material art forms, each defined by the medium or technique used to make the work.

support.rank_note: Members are arranged by structure of medium, from printed works to photographic images to handmade crafted objects, not ranked by degree.

points.title: Form
points.statement: Form is the aspect of the work concerned with its own structure, features and attributes, such as genre, theoretical approach, design elements and physical properties.
points.name: Form is the aspect of the work concerned with its own structure, features and attributes, such as genre, theoretical approach, design elements and physical properties.

support.rank_note: Sections run from features of texts to physical and design attributes.

points.statement: Textual form covers literary studies defined by a feature of the text itself, such as approach, medium, genre, readership or general scope.
points.name: Textual form covers literary studies defined by a feature of the text itself, such as approach, medium, genre, readership or general scope.

support.rank_note: From specific textual features to the general category.

points.statement: This group covers literary studies defined by theoretical approach, medium or type of text rather than by national tradition.
points.name: This group covers literary studies defined by theoretical approach, medium or type of text rather than by national tradition.

support.rank_note: Kinds are listed by approach without ranking.

points.statement: Each of these literary and cultural study fields is defined by a particular feature of a work that its analysis addresses, such as its environmental concerns or its physical production and circulation as a book.
points.name: Each of these literary and cultural study fields is defined by a particular feature of a work that its analysis addresses, such as its environmental concerns or its physical production and circulation as a book.

points.statement: Popular, genre, young adult and juvenile fiction are classified by the type of writing and the readership it is aimed at.
points.name: Popular, genre, young adult and juvenile fiction are classified by the type of writing and the readership it is aimed at.

support.rank_note: Ordered by structure, not by degree.

points.statement: General and unclassified literary studies cover work that is not tied to a particular region, genre or feature of the text.
points.name: General and unclassified literary studies cover work that is not tied to a particular region, genre or feature of the text.

support.rank_note: Ordered by structure, not by degree.

points.statement: Physical and design attributes cover the properties, design elements, colour and conditions that describe how a work looks and is made up.
points.name: Physical and design attributes cover the properties, design elements, colour and conditions that describe how a work looks and is made up.

support.rank_note: From general attributes to design elements and conditions.

points.title: Meaning
points.statement: Meaning is the aspect of the work concerned with the concepts, representations and subjects it expresses or is about.
points.name: Meaning is the aspect of the work concerned with the concepts, representations and subjects it expresses or is about.

support.rank_note: From abstract concepts to representation and subject matter.

points.statement: Theory and representation studies examine how images, identities and meanings are produced and conceptualised in culture.
points.name: Theory and representation studies examine how images, identities and meanings are produced and conceptualised in culture.

points.statement: Art history, theory and criticism not elsewhere classified
points.name: Art history, theory and criticism not elsewhere classified

support.rank_note: Ordered from visual cultures to general cultural theory.

points.statement: Traditional and musical expression literature covers the folk practices and musical works that a text is about.
points.name: Traditional and musical expression literature covers the folk practices and musical works that a text is about.

support.rank_note: Ordered from folklore to writing about music.

points.title: Context and reception
points.statement: Context and reception is the aspect of the work concerned with the place, tradition, language and cultural setting from which it comes and in which it is received.
points.name: Context and reception is the aspect of the work concerned with the place, tradition, language and cultural setting from which it comes and in which it is received.

support.rank_note: From literary origins by region and language outward to wider cultural setting.

points.statement: Regional literatures are defined by the region, nation or tradition from which the writing comes.
points.name: Regional literatures are defined by the region, nation or tradition from which the writing comes.

support.rank_note: From specific regions to broader traditions.

points.statement: This group covers the study of literature from Africa and Australia, defined by the region or nation of the writing.
points.name: This group covers the study of literature from Africa and Australia, defined by the region or nation of the writing.

points.statement: Australian literature (excl. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander literature)
points.name: Australian literature (excl. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander literature)

points.statement: Central and Eastern European literature (incl. Russian)
points.name: Central and Eastern European literature (incl. Russian)

support.rank_note: Kinds are listed by region without ranking.

points.statement: This group covers the study of literature from South, Southeast and East Asia written in Indian, Indonesian, Korean, Chinese and Japanese traditions.
points.name: This group covers the study of literature from South, Southeast and East Asia written in Indian, Indonesian, Korean, Chinese and Japanese traditions.

support.rank_note: Kinds are listed by region without ranking.

points.statement: Each of these fields studies the literature of a particular world region or tradition, such as Asian, Middle Eastern, North American or European writing, that has no field of its own.
points.name: Each of these fields studies the literature of a particular world region or tradition, such as Asian, Middle Eastern, North American or European writing, that has no field of its own.

points.statement: Language literatures are defined by the language community of the writing, such as classical, European, Spanish and Portuguese.
points.name: Language literatures are defined by the language community of the writing, such as classical, European, Spanish and Portuguese.

support.rank_note: From classical and European languages to Iberian and other regions.

points.statement: This group covers the study of literature defined by the language of the writing, namely classical Latin and Greek, French, German and Italian.
points.name: This group covers the study of literature defined by the language of the writing, namely classical Latin and Greek, French, German and Italian.

support.rank_note: Kinds are listed by language without ranking.

points.statement: Literatures of the Spanish, Portuguese, Middle Eastern, Asian, European, English-language and other regions are classified by the place or language community the work comes from.
points.name: Literatures of the Spanish, Portuguese, Middle Eastern, Asian, European, English-language and other regions are classified by the place or language community the work comes from.

points.statement: French literature - Italian literature - Spanish literature - Portuguese
points.name: French literature - Italian literature - Spanish literature - Portuguese

points.statement: German literature - Dutch literature - Flemish literature since 1830
points.name: German literature - Dutch literature - Flemish literature since 1830

support.rank_note: Ordered by structure of the regional scheme, not by degree.

points.statement: Literary studies of works defined by their language of composition, covering Spanish and Portuguese literature as well as literatures written in English beyond the major national traditions.
points.name: Literary studies of works defined by their language of composition, covering Spanish and Portuguese literature as well as literatures written in English beyond the major national traditions.

points.statement: Cultural setting covers how culture is situated in places, migrations, industries and media, and how it is organised and used.
points.name: Cultural setting covers how culture is situated in places, migrations, industries and media, and how it is organised and used.

support.rank_note: From place and movement to industry and media.

points.statement: Place-based cultural studies analyse culture in relation to particular regions, nations, environments and global flows.
points.name: Place-based cultural studies analyse culture in relation to particular regions, nations, environments and global flows.

points.statement: Cultural studies of nation and region
points.name: Cultural studies of nation and region

support.rank_note: Ordered from the whole discipline to regional then global scales.

points.statement: Migration and postcolonial studies investigate cultural encounters, movement of peoples and the legacies of colonialism.
points.name: Migration and postcolonial studies investigate cultural encounters, movement of peoples and the legacies of colonialism.

support.rank_note: Ordered from migrant experience to intercultural contact to postcolonial critique.

points.statement: Policy, industry and consumption studies look at how culture is organised, produced and used in economic and everyday life.
points.name: Policy, industry and consumption studies look at how culture is organised, produced and used in economic and everyday life.

points.statement: Cultural studies of agriculture, food and wine
points.name: Cultural studies of agriculture, food and wine

support.rank_note: Ordered from policy to industry to everyday consumption.

points.statement: Media-oriented cultural studies fields take screen media and general cultural analysis as the subject of the work.
points.name: Media-oriented cultural studies fields take screen media and general cultural analysis as the subject of the work.

support.rank_note: Ordered from the specific media field to the general residual category.

points.title: Value
points.statement: Value is the aspect of the work concerned with interpreting, evaluating and judging it within the broader scholarly and humanistic disciplines.
points.name: Value is the aspect of the work concerned with interpreting, evaluating and judging it within the broader scholarly and humanistic disciplines.

support.rank_note: From critical judgment of works to the disciplines that frame them.

points.statement: Art history, theory and criticism is the field of scholarship that interprets, evaluates and historically situates works of art.
points.name: Art history, theory and criticism is the field of scholarship that interprets, evaluates and historically situates works of art.

support.rank_note: Ordered from the whole field to its main sub-fields.

points.statement: Humanities-field concepts name the broad scholarly and artistic disciplines that frame a work as belonging to the humanities or arts.
points.name: Humanities-field concepts name the broad scholarly and artistic disciplines that frame a work as belonging to the humanities or arts.

support.rank_note: Ordered from the general humanities headings to the arts and music literature.

field_check.governing_thought: Arts and literature is divided by the feature of the work that a claim is about, running from the material object outward to judgment: medium and making, form, meaning, context and reception, and value.
key_line: Medium and making is the aspect of the work concerned with the material or expressive medium in which it is made and the practice of making it.
Form is the aspect of the work concerned with its own structure, features and attributes, such as genre, theoretical approach, design elements and physical properties.
Meaning is the aspect of the work concerned with the concepts, representations and subjects it expresses or is about.
Context and reception is the aspect of the work concerned with the place, tradition, language and cultural setting from which it comes and in which it is received.
Value is the aspect of the work concerned with interpreting, evaluating and judging it within the broader scholarly and humanistic disciplines.
field_check.note: Regional literatures (P4.1) and language literatures (P4.2) overlap on Asian, Middle Eastern and European groups; P2.1 literary-study groups overlap P4; P2.2, P3.1 and P3.2 are catalogue-style labels.
